newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SOCCER-VENABLES TURNED DOWN TURKEY JOB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VENABLES TURNED DOWN TURKEY JOB.

text.p: Former England coach Terry Venables said on Friday he turned down an offer to coach Turkey last year because of an undisclosed personal problem.

Venables, speaking on his arrival here to take up his position as Australia national team coach, said his services were in immediate demand after he stepped down from his position with England after the European championship last June.

"I was close to (accepting) one that was quite interesting," Venables told reporters at an airport news conference. "(But) I had a personal problem....if it had been under other circumstances maybe it would have been different."
After initially declining to say which country had approached him, Venables revealed it was Turkey.
He said he had been asked to give the Turks a speedy answer but was unable to do so because of his personal circumstances.
The former Barcelona and Tottenham Hotspur coach said he was also approached about several other high-profile jobs.
He will lead Australia for the first time in a four-nation tournament later this month involving Norway, New Zealand and South Korea.
Venables will be in charge of Australia's 1998 World Cup campaign, which begins later this year with qualifying matches in the Oceania group.
